entries.label: Maximum CPU frequency
entries.help: Highest frequency this cluster may use. Lower it to save power or raise it for more speed.

entries.label: Minimum CPU frequency
entries.help: Lowest frequency this cluster may drop to. Raising it can feel snappier but drains battery.

entries.label: CPU governor
entries.help: The policy that decides how this cluster scales between its frequencies.

entries.label: Governor parameters
entries.help: Advanced tunables for the currently selected governor.

entries.label: Core control
entries.help: Turns individual CPU cores on and off as load changes. Wrong values can hurt performance or stability.

entries.label: CPU online state
entries.help: Take individual CPU cores online or offline. Offlining cores changes performance and power.

entries.label: Cpusets
entries.help: Assign groups of processes to run only on chosen CPU cores.

entries.label: Stune
entries.help: Scheduler boost per process group. Higher boost favours performance over power.

entries.label: Uclamp
entries.help: Minimum and maximum utilisation hints the scheduler uses for each process group.
